last_obsidian_skill_map_audit.scope: /skills/graph spatial hierarchy, graph interaction, responsive behavior, and low-end performance
retained_strengths: Canvas 2D renderer with dynamic import and bounded simulation
separate visual meanings for demand, domain, saved skills, recommendations, and relationship strength
mobile document-scroll default with opt-in pan and pinch
critical_findings: The graph begins after search, metrics, quick links, a disclosure, and three large control cards, so the declared Map / Diagram hierarchy is not visible.
A normal node selection replaces topology, reheats the simulation, recenters the node, and zooms past 2x, destroying spatial memory.
The default 9–12 node local view cannot communicate the larger 60-node market landscape.
Typing in search changes the visible topology instead of locating a node in a stable map.
No semantic domain anchors exist, so the graph settles into a dense star rather than readable technology regions.
Recommendation and domain summaries below the graph duplicate the evidence rail and reduce the primary map area.
compared_directions: stable market atlas plus selected-skill spotlight
last_obsidian_skill_map_audit.selected_direction: stable market atlas plus selected-skill spotlight

last_actionable_obsidian_skill_graph_aud.scope: /skills/graph Obsidian interaction research translated into job-seeker decisions
last_actionable_obsidian_skill_graph_aud.research_conclusion: Obsidian's graph is useful for overview, neighborhood exploration, and path discovery, but an unfiltered global graph becomes a hairball. The product should adopt the exploration model rather than copy note-app controls.
adopted_patterns: stable global market atlas with explicit nearby exploration
core, balanced, and detailed relationship density without topology or camera changes
key and expanded label density without simulation restart
hover and selection reveal hidden contextual relationships
bounded market relationship path from owned skills to the selected skill
path explanation explicitly distinguishes co-requirement evidence from learning order
deliberately_not_copied: physics sliders that do not change a job-seeker decision
time-lapse and note-history controls unavailable in posting data
direction arrows for undirected co-requirement relationships
right-click note actions and vault-specific filters

last_skill_map_filter_motion_audit.scope: /skills/graph domain filtering, toolbar interaction, transition continuity, accessibility, and bounded rendering performance
root_causes: The first domain click removed a domain instead of isolating it, so the control did not match the user's filter mental model.
Display filtering replaced graph topology, reset readiness, reheated the force simulation, and refit the camera.
Independent disclosure elements allowed unclear menu state and exposed decorative arrow text in accessible button names.
An active single-domain filter was summarized only as a count, hiding which domain was applied.
Mobile domain counts were derived from a larger graph than the canvas layout, so a rare domain could promise nodes that were not present.
Context highlighting could temporarily preserve a relationship whose opposite endpoint had already left the active domain.
The force-graph pointer canvas could retain a filtered node until its throttled refresh, leaving an invisible click target.
The domain menu did not state the actual number of technologies rendered after applying a filter.

implemented_contract.domain_selection: empty means all; the first click isolates one domain; later clicks add or remove comparison domains; removing the last returns to all
implemented_contract.single_domain_summary: the selected Korean domain name is visible on the closed trigger
implemented_contract.layout_topology: desktop 60 nodes / 96 links; mobile 40 nodes / 64 links
implemented_contract.visible_budget: desktop 48 nodes / 84 links; mobile 30 nodes / 48 links
implemented_contract.transition: one requestAnimationFrame loop, 220ms opacity plus 0.88-to-1 node scale, with no React frame state
implemented_contract.reduced_motion: no spatial transform and immediate graph visibility resolution
implemented_contract.menu_behavior: one controlled menu at a time; outside pointer and Escape close; Escape restores trigger focus
implemented_contract.filter_source_of_truth: domain counts, displayed nodes, links, HUD metrics, and paths are derived from the same bounded canvas layout
implemented_contract.pointer_safety: the color-picking canvas is flushed when the visible node set changes and click, hover, cursor, and touch selection share the same visibility guard
implemented_contract.relationship_safety: context highlighting applies only while both link endpoints remain in the active node set
implemented_contract.accessible_result_feedback: the open domain menu reports the actual rendered technology count through a polite live region
